instructions.fields: Name is the only field: required text from 1 to 100 characters. Email and phone are not imported.
instructions.rules: Creates new clients only, never updates. Repeated names are allowed, as in the manual form. If any row fails, nothing is imported. Maximum 1000 rows.
instructions.example: Replace or delete the example row before importing. Fill in the first sheet, Clientes; empty rows are ignored.

instructions.codes: Enter existing active SKU and packaging codes.
instructions.groups: Blank group: fixed material; blank DEFAULT. With a group: explicit YES/NO and exactly one YES per group/variant.
instructions.unit: Unit: new associations use 1 per unit; existing quantities are preserved.
instructions.intermediate: Intermediate: uses the existing variant configuration.
instructions.pallet: Pallet: new associations copy catalog consumption; existing associations preserve their rule. Configure the catalog before importing.
instructions.legacy: Legacy format with BASE DE CANTIDAD and CANTIDAD: temporary explicit configuration; complete both values for pallet materials.
instructions.limits: Maximum 1,000 rows and 5 MB. Validate and review before confirming.
instructions.costs: Catalog costs remain in USD; this file does not change material names or prices.

instructions.sheets: One row per variant in Productos y Variantes; one row per material in Materiales de Empaque. SKU links the sheets.
instructions.references: Creates only: SKU must be new and present in sheet one. Packaging code, presentation, client and subcategory must exist and be active; category is required and the subcategory must belong to it. Imported products are created as non-organic. The Organic column in older templates is ignored. Use individual creation or editing to register an organic product.
instructions.groups: Product group links variants; repeat product fields consistently. Option group must exist: grouped materials require YES/NO and exactly one YES per SKU/group; fixed materials leave group and default blank.
instructions.rules: Explicit types: INDIVIDUAL=1 per unit; CAJA=1 per box; ESQUINERO=4 per pallet; TARIMA=1 per pallet; STRETCH=93.3 per pallet. Basis/quantity may be blank; supplied values must match.
instructions.other: OTRO PALETIZACIÓN requires POR CAJA/POR PALLET and a positive quantity with at most two decimal places.
instructions.intermediate: INTERMEDIO requires units per intermediate package on the variant; basis/quantity blank. Existing calculation is preserved.
instructions.compatibility: Sheet two is optional; legacy single-sheet files still work. Maximum 5 MB, 5000 variants and 1000 materials. Do not use formulas.
instructions.catalog: Materials/groups are not created and catalog defaults are not changed. Conflicting defaults are errors. Pallet alternatives in a group share consumption.
instructions.after: Validate both sheets and review preview before confirmation. Everything is created in one transaction; any error cancels everything. Configure images, recipes and ingredients afterward.
